evals.name: java-checkout-seeded
evals.prompt: Review the publishing code in evals/review-pubsub-publishing/files/checkout-java, a Spring Boot checkout service. Some orders never seem to reach the subscribers.
evals.expected_output: A read-only publishing report with 'Language: java'. Critical: DPS-PUB-001 (src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:46, publishEvent Mono never subscribed), DPS-PUB-002 (:54, empty catch (DaprException) then 202), DPS-PUB-003 (:72, 'order-bus' matches no component; the component is 'pubsub'). Warnings: DPS-PUB-006 (:106, new DaprClientBuilder().build() in a method, never closed), DPS-PUB-007 (:85, publishEvents response never read for getFailedEntries), DPS-PUB-008 (:94, cloudevent.traceparent metadata), DPS-PUB-013 (src/main/java/com/example/checkout/MessagingConfiguration.java:16, new DaprMessagingTemplate; LegacyOrderPublisher.java calls send). Suggestions: DPS-PUB-009 (the 'orders' literal at CheckoutController.java:72 and LegacyOrderPublisher.java:16), DPS-PUB-014 (src/main/java/com/example/checkout/BulkOrderPublisher.java:32, publishEvents on DaprPreviewClient). Please verify: DPS-PUB-010 (:78, a List<OrderPlaced> as one event), DPS-PUB-012 (:100, rawPayload). Not reported: the blocked publish at :40, the catch at :63 that returns 503, BulkOrderPublisher's failed-entries check, the buildPreviewClient() @Bean, ttl-free publishes. DPS-PUB-004, DPS-PUB-005 and DPS-PUB-011 do not appear.
expectations: The report starts with the heading '# Dapr review — review-pubsub-publishing' and its header contains 'Language: java'

The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-001] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:46 (publishEvent result neither blocked, returned nor subscribed, so nothing is published); the Why or Fix says the Mono is lazy / must be .block()ed or returned
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-002] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:54 (lines 52-56 acceptable): an empty catch (DaprException) followed by a 202 Accepted
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-003] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:72 stating that the pub/sub name 'order-bus' differs from the component name 'pubsub'

The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-006] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:106 (new DaprClientBuilder().build() inside a request method, never closed), with a Fix to inject the autoconfigured DaprClient

The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-007] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:85 (lines 84-86 acceptable): the BulkPublishResponse is assigned but getFailedEntries() is never read. The List passed to publishEvents is not reported as DPS-PUB-010
The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-008] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:94 (lines 93-94 acceptable) for the cloudevent.traceparent metadata key

The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-013] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/MessagingConfiguration.java:16 (new DaprMessagingTemplate), explaining the fixed 10-second TTL that makes a failing message expire instead of reaching the dead-letter topic; the Fix is DaprClient.publishEvent(...).block(). A second DPS-PUB-013 location at LegacyOrderPublisher.java:16 is tolerated (it raises the warning count by 1)

The Suggestions section contains [DPS-PUB-009] citing src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:72 and naming LegacyOrderPublisher.java:16 (the repeated "orders" topic literal), and [DPS-PUB-014] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/BulkOrderPublisher.java:32 (lines 31-33 acceptable; publishEvents on the deprecated DaprPreviewClient)

The Please verify section (not Critical or Warnings) contains [DPS-PUB-010] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:78 (a List<OrderPlaced> published as one event) and [DPS-PUB-012] at src/main/java/com/example/checkout/CheckoutController.java:100 (rawPayload "true")

The report does NOT report the blocked publish at CheckoutController.java:40, the catch at :63 that returns 503, BulkOrderPublisher's publishEvents for DPS-PUB-007 (it reads getFailedEntries), or the buildPreviewClient() @Bean for DPS-PUB-006. DPS-PUB-004, DPS-PUB-005 and DPS-PUB-011 do not appear

The Found: line reads 'Found: 3 critical, 4 warnings, 2 suggestions, 2 to verify' (5 warnings if the tolerated second DPS-PUB-013 location is reported as its own finding). Critical findings come before Warnings, and the report ends with '## Next steps' with no text after it
Uses only Read, Grep and Glob (no mvn call); the project files under review are unchanged and the report contains no instruction or claim that the review modified files
